# javaabu/post-types

> WordPress-style post types for Laravel. Post types (news, events, pages) are defined fluently with PostTypes::register(PostType::make('news')->labels(...)->supports([...])->taxonomies([...])->metaFields([...])->permalink('{year}/{slug}')); every post type's posts are rows of Javaabu\PostTypes\Models\Post with a type. Taxonomies (categories, tags) are shared, flat or hierarchical. Statuses: draft, pending, published and your own; a future publish date schedules a post. Meta fields use javaabu/meta, media javaabu/mediapicker, content javaabu/block-editor. Route::postTypesAdmin() adds admin pages with javaabu/filters and javaabu/bulk-actions; Route::postTypes() adds archives, term archives and single posts with configurable permalinks and overridable templates. Blade or Inertia React. Permissions per post type through javaabu/permissions, any guard. Optional javaabu/translatable and javaabu/dynamic-menubuilder. English and Dhivehi, RTL.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/post-types/.

## Rules

- Register taxonomies and post types in a service provider's boot() (or config('post-types.types')). Never add a model, migration, controller or views per post type; add fields with ->metaFields() and pickers with ->media().
- Post type and taxonomy keys are permanent: they're stored on posts and name routes and permissions. Labels are plain strings or closures, translated when shown; add them to lang/dv.json.
- Query through the post type: `PostTypes::get('news')->query()->published()`, or `Post::query()->ofType('news')`. Use `published()` (not a status check) so scheduled posts stay hidden. Use `PostTypes::postModel()` when you need the class: it's the translatable model when javaabu/translatable is enabled.
- A post's URL is `$post->permalink()`; a term archive is `$term->archiveUrl('news')`; an archive is `PostTypes::get('news')->archiveUrl()`. Never build them by hand, and never call `url()` on posts (it's translatable's).
- Assign terms with `$post->syncTerms('categories', [...])` or the `taxonomies` attribute; meta with `meta` or `setMeta()`.
- Register routes yourself: `Route::postTypesAdmin([...guard, prefix, name])` and `Route::postTypes()` (after your other routes). Run `php artisan permissions:sync`, then give roles view_/edit_/delete_/force_delete_/publish_{type} and view_/edit_/delete_{taxonomy}.
- Change public templates with resources/views/post-types/{type}/{archive|term|single}.blade.php or ->views()/->pages(); change behaviour by extending PostsController, PostForm, PostFilters, PostBulkActions or the policies and setting them in config.
- Meta fields sit under `meta` in the post form: conditions use full paths (`visibleWhen('meta.featured', true)`).
- Pass every user-facing string through `__()` and add it to lang/dv.json.
